jobs.description:
Job Title: NOC Engineer

About the Client: ﻿Our client is a managed service provider (MSP) that delivers IT infrastructure management, network monitoring, and technical support to multiple business clients. They help maintain network and server performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure reliable IT operations across client environments.

Overview:

The NOC Engineer is the first line of response for the alerts that keep client environments healthy and secure. This role responds to and triages backup alerts, security alerts, and monitoring alerts, including devices and services that go offline, and drives each one to resolution or a clean, well-documented escalation, especially in the case of ISP outages and working with 3rd party ISP vendors.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong critical thinking, disciplined time management, and excellent communication skills. They know when to act, when to escalate, and how to keep clients and teammates informed.

Responsibilities:

Alert Response and Triage

  • Backup alerts. Monitor, respond to, and triage backup alerts, including failed, missed, and warning backup jobs.
  • Monitoring alerts. Respond to monitoring alerts such as offline servers, workstations, and services. Verify scope and impact, perform initial troubleshooting, and restore service or escalate.
  • Security alerts. Monitor and triage security alerts from endpoint and managed detection and response tools and determine whether an alert is a false positive or requires remediation.

Incident Handling

  • Follow documented SOPs for alert triage, documenting steps taken, and escalating as needed.
  • Perform basic data and system restores in accordance with documented procedures and client requirements.
  • Contact clients, ISPs, vendors, and internal resources as needed to understand scope and impact.
  • Escalate issues to the appropriate team member with clear context, evidence, and steps already taken.

Ticketing, Documentation, and Communication

  • Create, manage, and update tickets generated from alerts or assigned tasks, keeping notes clear, complete, and timely.
  • Keep clients and teammates informed with concise, professional status updates, including impact, actions underway, and next steps.
  • Use and update IT Glue documentation, and flag missing or outdated SOPs and runbooks.

Systems and Tools

The NOC Engineer should be familiar with, or able to quickly become proficient in, the following:

  • Microsoft Windows: Full familiarity with Windows Operating Systems and technologies.
  • Microsoft 365: Familiar with Entra AD, Office 365, Email and Exchange Online.
  • NinjaOne RMM: Device monitoring, offline-device alerts, remote access and remediation, backup/monitoring alert triage.
  • ConnectWise Manage: Ticket creation, management, updates, escalation, and time entry.
  • IT Glue: Client documentation, SOPs, runbooks, credentials and configuration references.
  • CrowdStrike: Endpoint detection and response alert review, triage, and containment actions per SOP.
  • PRTG Network Monitoring Software: Network monitoring, ISP outage remediation.
  • Datto BCDR: Backup viability and test restores.

Qualifications:

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and desktop operating systems, Microsoft 365, and basic networking concepts.
  • Critical thinking. Able to analyze unfamiliar problems, separate facts from assumptions, and choose a sound course of action.
  • Self-starter. Takes initiative, works with minimal supervision, and follows through without being prompted.
  • Time management. Manages a continuous flow of alerts and tickets, prioritizing by impact and urgency and meeting response targets.
  • Communication. Writes and speaks clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients under stress.
  • SOP adherence. Follows documented procedures accurately.
  • Restores. Able to perform basic restores and verify they completed successfully.

Technical Knowledge

Education and Experience

At least 2 years of recent helpdesk, NOC, or systems support experience in the small or mid-sized MSP vertical, is preferred.

Emotional and Interpersonal Demands

The NOC Engineer must be emotionally mature and able to handle difficult and complex client and work-related situations, with strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and interpersonal skills, and a positive attitude.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and present information to others and to access information using a computer for several hours at a time.

Measurables

  • Incident and event time to response
  • Average age of tickets
  • Average time to resolution

Schedule: Night Shift
﻿Setup: Remote

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
    • HMO Day 1 + FREE dependent coverage
    • Allowances
    • Attendance bonus
    • Paid time offs
  • Company-provided work setup (laptop, monitor, accessories)
  • Training, career growth, and global exposure
  • A collaborative and supportive team culture

If you're a motivated, client-focused professional who's ready to grow with a company that values people and performance, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and join our dynamic team at STAFFVIRTUAL!

Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

Why This Seat

  • An SVP who wants to hand this over. Not one who says that and then rewrites your deck. The explicit goal is that the HR function runs without him.
  • Executive reach by default. Calibration and leveling decisions live with the C-suite, and you present your own work. You won't spend year one convincing anyone that performance management matters.
  • Leverage is part of the mandate, not a side project. We are tech-first and AI-forward, which means we can run lean teams and do more with less. You'll push that further, build the tooling managers actually open, and make everything easier without taking substance out of it. Nobody will ask you to do it the slow way.

How This Team Is Led

From Kris Osborne, SVP of Talent.

I'll tell you what I want and what the constraints are and then get out of the way. I don't rewrite people's work. If I disagree with where you landed you'll hear it from me early, and if you still think you're right then push back, because I'd rather change my mind than have you go quiet and build something you don't believe in.

I ask before I decide. When something changes the shape of this team the people on it hear it from me first and they get a real say in it, not a heads up after it's done.

I care about the outcome and I'm not going to do your job for you. Bring me a problem and I'll work it with you, but I'm not going to take it off your plate and hand it back finished.

I'm hiring this seat because I want someone we can all learn from. Bring me a better answer than mine and I'll take it.

What You'll Bring

All required.

  • A full performance cycle you owned end to end, not supported. Owned more than once, at 150 people or more. Design, timeline, manager prep, calibration, rollout, retro.
  • Compensation and benefits you've owned. Band design, benchmarking methodology, benefits renewals, the annual comp cycle. You can defend a number to a CFO.
  • HR compliance as standing scope, not as a project. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. You've inherited a backlog and cleared it.
  • A people system that outlasted you. Built, adopted, and still recognizable two cycles later.
  • Leverage you built that people adopted. You've automated or rebuilt part of a people process so it ran faster, the quality held or improved, and the team actually used it. Adoption is the test here, the same way durability is the test above.
  • Experience taking a company our size to materially larger, on headcount or revenue, more than once. You know what breaks first at the next stage because you've watched it break.
  • Empowered your team to raise the bar. You have clear examples of coaching, mentoring, and growing a team that created extraordinary outcomes.

This is a player-coach seat. Managers here lead a team and deliver work personally, at every level.

Nice to Have

  • You have opinions about what performance management gets wrong, and specific examples of what you changed
  • You can tell a process problem from a manager-capability problem, and you fix the right one
  • You're the person who says the uncomfortable thing in a calibration room

What You'll Own

Performance management. The mid-year and annual cycles end to end: design, timeline, communication, execution. What the cycle needs to produce and what to cut. A timeline published early enough that managers plan around it. The retro after each one, and the judgment about when a change is warranted and when to leave it alone.

Total rewards. Band design and the benchmarking methodology behind it. Benefits renewals and the economics underneath them. The annual comp cycle, with leveling and pay kept connected.

Compliance. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. The current backlog, plus the escalation and coverage protocols that follow it.

Manager enablement. Preparing managers for real performance conversations, including the one where someone rated themselves higher than their manager did. The calibration process, including where two managers apply the same bar differently. Playbooks and self-service resources so a manager gets an answer without booking a meeting. Standing support for the roughly three dozen front-line managers who get it reactively today.

Leverage and tooling. Finding the parts of everything above that shouldn't be done by hand, and fixing them. Building what a manager will actually open rather than what looks good in a demo. Taking time out of the cycle while the conversations get better rather than thinner.

The team. An HR Business Partner and a Total Rewards and People Analytics lead. Both are strong at what they do and both have room to grow. You set their decision rights: where they decide, where they recommend, where it comes to you.

What Great Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The annual cycle ships on your timeline and you own it
  • Managers are calibrated before the cycle rather than corrected after it
  • Every person leaving a check-in has one clear thing to work on, and the conversation that produced it was a real one
  • The compliance backlog is closed and stays closed
  • The cycle costs managers less time than the year before, and the conversations are better rather than thinner
  • Your two reports hold more decision authority than they did at the start

This Isn't the Right Seat If

  • This would be your first Director-level people role
  • You lead with policy and risk. Compliance is required here and it isn't the center of the work
  • You want to redesign the cycle every year
  • You see tooling and automation as somebody else's job
  • You're looking for a recruiting role. Recruiting sits elsewhere in the function

jobs.title: Staff Storage Platform Engineer (AI Storage) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: About Radian Arc.  We're specialists in outcome-optimized AI infrastructure - deploying, orchestrating and monetizing GPU compute where data, users and demand actually meet: inside telco networks, at the edge, and in core data centers.
jobs.description:
About Radian Arc.
We're specialists in outcome-optimized AI infrastructure - deploying, orchestrating and monetizing GPU compute where data, users and demand actually meet: inside telco networks, at the edge, and in core data centers. Not a generic AI platform. Not a consultancy. We’re the bridge between raw silicon and real-world results.

What impact you will have

Mission: Design, build, and operate the AI storage layer powering large-scale GPU infrastructure, enabling datasets, model artifacts, checkpoints, and inference state to be delivered to compute clusters with extremely high throughput and predictable latency.

You will play a key role in architecting and evolving the storage platform across edge and core deployments, supporting the full lifecycle of AI workloads including distributed inference, fine-tuning, and large-scale model training. The role spans multiple storage architectures used across the platform, including hyperconverged storage currently based on StorPool, local NVMe storage for latency-sensitive workloads and edge deployments, and disaggregated AI storage platforms such as VAST Data and Weka.

As the first dedicated storage platform role in the organization, this position combines Staff-level architectural ownership, technical direction, and cross-functional influence with hands-on execution across storage design, deployment, performance engineering, troubleshooting, platform integration, and operational improvement.

A key responsibility of this role is designing and optimizing the storage architecture underlying distributed inference stacks such as NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d, or similar inference orchestration frameworks. This includes ensuring that storage systems efficiently support inference workloads through optimized dataset access, model artifact distribution, checkpoint handling, and KV-cache persistence. You will design scalable storage systems capable of feeding thousands of GPUs while balancing throughput, latency, resilience, and cost efficiency, and work closely with compute, networking, and platform engineering teams to ensure seamless integration with the platform orchestration layer.

Because this is currently the primary storage platform role in the company, the position is intentionally hybrid: you are expected to operate at L6 / Staff in terms of long-term design, standards, cross-team influence, and platform direction, while also directly executing critical storage work that, in a larger organization, would be distributed across multiple engineers.

This is a fully remote role, we will consider relevant candidates in all locations.

What you'll need

Core Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience designing and operating distributed storage systems for high-performance compute environments.
  • Proven experience designing storage architectures for large-scale AI inference or training platforms, including dataset distribution, checkpointing, and KV-cache storage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux storage and I/O stack.
  • Strong understanding of AI workload data access patterns.
  • Experience optimizing storage for GPU-accelerated workloads.
  • WEKA Data Platform (an enterprise high-performance storage system for AI and HPC)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes storage integrations such as CSI.
  • Experience operating large-scale storage clusters.
  • Experience owning both architecture and direct implementation in lean or fast-scaling environments is strongly preferred.

Advanced AI Storage Expertise

The candidate should have deep expertise in designing and operating storage platforms optimized for GPU-heavy environments and distributed AI workloads.

This includes a strong understanding of how training, fine-tuning, and inference systems interact with storage, and how storage architecture affects throughput, latency, concurrency, checkpoint recovery, dataset distribution, and serving performance.

Relevant expertise includes:

  • Strong understanding of storage access patterns for distributed inference and training.
  • Experience designing storage platforms that support large dataset ingestion and model artifact distribution at scale.
  • Practical experience tuning storage architectures for checkpointing, distributed file access, object access, and high-concurrency inference.
  • Familiarity with storage patterns for KV-cache persistence and retrieval.
  • Experience optimizing data locality and reducing unnecessary network movement between storage and compute.
  • Understanding of how storage performance affects large-scale AI frameworks, model-serving systems, and inference orchestration layers.

Systems & Troubleshooting

  • Ability to debug complex cross-layer issues spanning:
    • Storage hardware,
    • Networking,
    • Linux kernel and I/O paths,
    • Filesystems,
    • Object and block storage layers,
    • Kubernetes integrations,
    • Distributed workload behavior.
  • Strong knowledge of storage hardware, NVMe devices, storage fabrics, and high-performance data paths.
  • Experience designing storage observability systems.
  • Strong ability to act as the senior escalation point for ambiguous, high-impact, and multi-domain technical issues.

Automation

  • Strong automation skills using Python and/or Bash.
  • Experience applying software engineering practices to storage automation and operational tooling.
  • Experience building reusable tooling, standards, validation patterns, or lifecycle automation that increase leverage across teams.

Leadership

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams.
  • Comfortable collaborating across engineering, operations, deployment teams, vendors, and platform stakeholders.
  • Strong systems-level thinking balancing performance, reliability, scalability, operability, and cost efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to set architectural direction and drive adoption of engineering standards across an organization.
  • Proven ability to lead through technical influence across multiple teams and domains, without relying on formal people management authority.
  • Strong mentoring capability and ability to raise the technical level of adjacent engineering teams.
  • Able to balance short-term execution needs with long-term platform design, operational sustainability, and cost efficiency.

What you’ll do

Storage Architecture

  • Design scalable AI storage architectures supporting both edge and core deployments.
  • Define storage strategies for distributed inference, fine-tuning, and training workloads.
  • Architect solutions across multiple storage models:
    • Hyperconverged infrastructure such as StorPool,
    • Local NVMe storage,
    • Disaggregated storage systems such as VAST, Weka, and related architectures.
  • Define reference architectures, design principles, and reusable patterns for storage platforms so future deployments follow standards rather than one-off implementations.
  • Evaluate trade-offs across throughput, latency, resilience, data locality, cost, and operability, and make clear recommendations to engineering and leadership.
  • Influence the long-term storage roadmap, including architecture choices for edge, core, hyperconverged, and disaggregated environments.

AI Workload Optimization

  • Optimize storage throughput and latency for GPU-heavy clusters.
  • Design data locality strategies to minimize dataset movement across the network.
  • Benchmark storage performance under real AI workloads.
  • Optimize I/O patterns for large dataset ingestion, checkpointing, and model artifact distribution.
  • Work directly with compute teams to ensure storage architecture matches the access patterns of distributed training, fine-tuning, and inference frameworks.
  • Establish performance baselines and validation methods so storage platforms are tested against realistic AI workload behavior rather than only synthetic benchmarks.

Platform Integration

  • Implement and maintain CSI drivers.
  • Integrate storage platforms with Kubernetes and orchestration systems.
  • Integrate block, object, and shared file storage into the platform.
  • Design multi-tenant storage architectures supporting isolated workloads.
  • Ensure storage capabilities are correctly exposed into platform services, workload orchestration, and lifecycle automation.
  • Define standards for how storage should be integrated into Kubernetes-based and platform-managed environments across different deployment models.

Distributed Storage Systems

  • Contribute to the design of exabyte-scale storage platforms.
  • Support S3-compatible object storage, distributed file systems, and block storage.
  • Integrate storage clusters into heterogeneous customer environments.
  • Design storage systems with clear fault domains, lifecycle management approaches, scaling paths, and operational boundaries.
  • Define reusable operating patterns for multi-cluster and multi-site storage environments.

Distributed Inference Storage Architecture

  • Design the storage architecture supporting distributed inference platforms such as NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d, or similar frameworks.
  • Optimize storage performance for large-scale LLM inference workloads.
  • Design efficient strategies for KV-cache persistence and retrieval using distributed storage platforms such as VAST or Weka.
  • Optimize storage access patterns for token generation pipelines and high-concurrency inference workloads.
  • Ensure inference infrastructure scales efficiently across thousands of GPUs.
  • Partner with platform and inference teams to ensure storage design supports evolving inference architectures and avoids becoming a bottleneck in throughput, latency, or concurrency.

AI Data Path Optimization

  • Design high-performance data paths between GPU clusters and distributed storage.
  • Optimize performance using technologies such as:
    • GPU Direct Storage,
    • RDMA / RoCE,
    • NVMe-oF.
  • Ensure predictable latency for inference serving workloads.
  • Define architectural approaches for storage-to-GPU data movement that balance performance gains with operational complexity and deployment practicality.

Performance Engineering

  • Work with technologies such as the following, to maximize data throughput to GPU clusters.:
    • RDMA,
    • RoCE,
    • GPU Direct Storage,
    • SPDK,
    • NVMe-oF,
  • Lead storage performance investigations across hardware, network, OS, filesystem, and workload interaction points.
  • Drive systematic tuning of storage paths for large-scale GPU environments and define repeatable validation and benchmarking approaches for future deployments.

Reliability & Operations

  • Improve the reliability, durability, and observability of the storage stack.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to monitor storage systems using telemetry and metrics.
  • Optimize performance, latency, and resilience of storage infrastructure.
  • Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for major storage events and chronic performance issues.
  • Translate operational pain points and incidents into durable design changes, standards, runbooks, and architectural improvements.
  • Establish measurable benchmarks for storage reliability, performance consistency, recovery behavior, and operability across deployments.

Engineering Execution & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end engineering delivery of storage infrastructure from architecture and validation through production rollout.
  • Support practical implementation of storage platforms in both new deployments and existing environments.
  • Validate storage BOMs and architecture assumptions together with infrastructure, compute, and deployment teams.
  • Contribute detailed input into datacenter layouts, node profiles, and storage topology decisions.
  • Drive scaling strategies, capacity planning, and storage lifecycle decisions.
  • Ensure storage changes are executed safely with minimal customer impact.
  • Act as both the architectural owner and the practical execution lead for critical storage initiatives during the build-out phase of the storage function.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with compute, networking, platform, DevOps, and operations teams.
  • Ensure storage integrates seamlessly into the AI platform architecture.
  • Act as the primary storage design authority across the organization, guiding adjacent teams on how storage constraints and capabilities should shape platform decisions.
  • Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and operational implications clearly to stakeholders.
  • Share knowledge and mentor engineers on high-performance storage design.
  • Raise the technical bar by helping adjacent teams better understand storage behavior in distributed AI environments.

Technical Stack

  • CSI.
  • NVMe / NVMe-oF.
  • Distributed file systems.
  • Object storage.
  • Linux storage stack.
  • RDMA / RoCE.
  • GPU Direct Storage.
  • SPDK.
  • StorPool.
  • VAST Data.
  • Weka.
  • MinioFS.
  • Rook Ceph.

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

jobs.description:
About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.
We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.
The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Data Manager at the Working Families Party (WFP) ensures that data tools smoothly supercharge our organizing.

Every tool has a data side and an organizing side: the Data Manager is responsible for the data side of our tools. They work closely with those responsible for the organizing side to maximize our impact on campaigns and as a movement.

Based in the Data Department, this role takes responsibility for the ownership and management of the data systems for WFP’s core organizing software, such as EveryAction, VAN, Votivate, Scale to Win, and Mobilize. This role requires a balance of backend tool administration expertise and frontline stakeholder collaboration skills. They are the primary touchpoint for organizers seeking hands-on data support at the Party.

The Data Manager plays a major role in ensuring data integrity for our single sources of truth in a large, multi-state, highly-coalition-oriented organization. They have lead responsibility for quality assurance and quality checks (QA/QC) of our organizing tool data. The Data Manager will draw upon their deep familiarity with the data structures and quirks – both on the user-interface and data table side – from previous campaigns. This person will leverage their expertise writing SQL queries to frequently access data from our BigQuery data warehouse to pull lists and calculate metrics for organizers.

This is a highly collaborative role. They are responsible for supporting tool adoption and making technical information accessible through training and documentation. They act as a thought partner to organizers and staff to develop effective data organization systems. They conduct training and prepare standards on the data side of tools so that organizers know how to cleanly generate and upload data in our systems.

The Data Manager coordinates with other members of the Data Department; for example, when the Engineering Team needs to create a new sync or data model. The Data Manager proactively engages the Analytics Director and Data Director for prioritization, consults, and progress reporting and bases decisionmaking on wider Party, Department, and Team strategy.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    Data Systems Ownership

  • Serve as an in-house data expert on organizing tools, including EveryAction, Mobilize, VAN, Votivate, and others. Design and implement approaches to organize data and processes in these systems and take ownership of data maintenance.

  • Develop systems, structures, templates, processes, and documentation that organizers can apply in practice to enter, modify, and retrieve data.

  • In addition to organizing tools, own Party infrastructure such as WFP’s endorsement and elected official processes and maintain these databases. Ensure that the systems design meets organizational needs, that data processes are clear and understood, that data is collected in a timely manner, and conduct quality assurance and quality checks.

    • Maintain Data Integrity

  • Ensure that our data systems serve as single sources of truth for our organizing work by maintaining clean, accurate, and well-documented data.

  • Develop quality assurance processes to ensure that data generation is standardized across our suite of voter contact tools.

  • Continuously conduct quality checks and standardize data to ensure datasets are a high-fidelity, usable reflection of reality.

  • Audit organizing tools regularly to ensure proper permissioning and that data protocols (e.g., naming conventions) are being used across the organization.

    • Data Support

  • Serve as one of the main points of contact for data needs across the organization, responding to requests from organizers, fundraisers, and all Divisions through the Data Department’s ticketing system.

  • Troubleshoot organizers’ data challenges with organizing tools, including those around permissions, bulk uploading, etc.

  • Train and support organizers on the data aspects of tool use: the mechanics of using the tools and our processes and structures for ensuring clean, usable data. Coordinate with other teams to support advanced training.

  • Supporting organizers by setting up API integrations between tools (e.g., VAN and Scale to Win).

  • Provide additional capacity to enter, modify, and retrieve data to organizers.

  • Work closely with organizers to resolve data issues, identify tool gaps, and implement improvements that streamline program work.

    • Data Requests and Reporting

  • Write accurate, efficient SQL queries in accordance with WFP DATA Department best practices in order to answer a range of inquiries and questions about our data spanning multiple programmatic areas.

  • Provide data visualizations and reporting that delivers actionable insight into WFP’s electoral and member organizing.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 2 years of experience working for candidate campaigns and movement organizations in data and organizer roles

  • Experience and deep familiarity administrating electoral software tools (e.g., VAN, EveryAction, Mobilize, Scale to Win).

  • Facility with SQL and BigQuery in political contexts.

  • Experience using Google Sheets and/or Airtable in advanced organizing contexts.

  • Deep familiarity with at least one and ideally multiple national voterfile products (TargetSmart, Catalist, L2), including scores.

  • Experience with using Google Data Studio, Hex, or other platforms for data visualization and reporting.

  • Experience self-organizing data projects from beginning to end: scoping, design, gathering input, implementation, maintenance, and improvement.

  • Facility with analytical reasoning to troubleshoot both technical and stakeholder problems. Ability to recognize patterns and are careful to check assumptions–whether they are your own or someone else’s.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a keen eye for design.

  • Confident in their ability to design and implement a system that addresses the needs of multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience in a fast-paced, stakeholder-support role (tickets, requests).

Applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor, or take over sponsorship of, employment visas at this time.

Location:Remote (U.S.):must hold an active, unrestricted medical license in one or more states as assigned

Employment Type:Independent Contractor / Per-Case Reviewer (1099) — panel appointment

About the Role

The Clinician Reviewer conducts independent, evidence-based medical necessity reviews for appeals involving Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS), Personal Assistance Services (PAS), and In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS). These cases typically involve disputes over the type, amount, or duration of in-home or community-based care authorized for individuals with chronic illness, disability, or functional impairment. Reviewers render clinically sound, defensible, and regulation-compliant determinations. This is a specialty niche within utilization/independent review: LTSS, PAS, and IHSS appeals turn on functional and activities-of-daily-living (ADL) assessment. Clinicians must be comfortable evaluating functional capacity, caregiver need, and level-of-care documentation rather than solely clinical/diagnostic criteria.

What You'll Do

  • Review case files consisting of functional assessments (e.g., ADL/IADL scales, standardized LTSS assessment tools), physician orders, care plans, prior authorizations, denial letters, and appellant-submitted evidence.
  • Apply the applicable medical necessity criteria, state Medicaid/waiver program guidelines, and nationally recognized standards to determine whether the disputed PAS/IHSS/LTSS services are medically necessary and appropriately scoped.
  • Render written determinations that clearly explain the clinical rationale, cite the specific evidence relied upon, address the appellant's stated basis for appeal, and expressly address the applicable state-specific definitions, eligibility criteria, and level-of-care guidelines governing the PAS/IHSS/LTSS program at issue.
  • Identify and disclose any conflicts of interest prior to accepting a case assignment.
  • Complete assigned reviews within state-mandated and accreditation-mandated turnaround times.
  • Maintain current knowledge of the LTSS, PAS, and IHSS regulatory and clinical landscape, including state-specific waiver programs and level-of-care criteria.

Required Experience

Direct clinical experience with the LTSS/PAS/IHSS population:

  • Minimum 3 years of clinical practice involving elderly, disabled, or chronically ill patients who require or receive long-term services and supports, personal care assistance, or in-home supportive care.
  • Direct experience recommending, ordering, or certifying PAS/IHSS/LTSS-type services — for example, completing physician certifications for in-home care hours, signing plans of care for home health or personal care aides, or authorizing durable medical equipment/home modifications tied to functional need.
  • Familiarity with standardized functional assessment instruments commonly used in LTSS/PAS/IHSS determinations (e.g., ADL/IADL indices, MDS-HC, InterRAI, or state-specific level-of-care tools).
  • Working knowledge of Medicaid home- and community-based services (HCBS) waivers, state IHSS or PAS programs, and the distinction between medical necessity criteria for acute/institutional care versus in-home functional support.
  • Experience treating populations with conditions commonly underlying LTSS/PAS/IHSS need — e.g., frailty, dementia and other cognitive impairments, spinal cord injury, cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke, and other conditions causing chronic functional decline.

Board certification (ABMS or AOA) in a specialty relevant to the population served — e.g., Internal Medicine, Geriatric Medicine, Family Medicine, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, or Neurology — with active, unrestricted licensure.

Five years of active practice with direct patient care within the past year.

Independent review experience: Prior experience as an IRO, UR, or peer reviewer, including familiarity with URAC standards, is strongly preferred; training will be provided for physicians new to formal review work but who meet the direct clinical criteria above.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience serving as a treating or certifying physician within a state IHSS, PAS, or Medicaid HCBS waiver program.
  • Experience with disability determination reviews (e.g., SSA) or workers' compensation functional capacity evaluations.
  • Familiarity with InterQual and/or MCG care guidelines as applied to home-based and long-term care.

Conflict-of-Interest & Independence Requirements

  • No current or prior treating relationship with the appellant.
  • No financial or contractual relationship with the requesting health plan, state agency, or IHSS/PAS program administrator that could reasonably be perceived to affect independence.
  • Must disclose any circumstance that could create actual or apparent bias prior to case acceptance, consistent with state IRO independence requirements.

Compensation

Paid per completed case review, with rates commensurate with case complexity and turnaround urgency.

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

We’re seeking Master’s-level professionals who feel confident facilitating Substance Use Disorder groups, collaborating closely with therapists, and thriving in a part-time, fully remote telehealth environment.

jobs.excerpt: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $16 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80,000 employees, including more than 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com

BUSINESS UNIT DESCRIPTION

Digital Data Networks (DDN) business in TE Connectivity you will play a key role in the design of products for high-speed products in the connector, cable assembly, and/or radio system industry—targeting high-speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Product Security Leader is responsible for defining, implementing, and governing the cybersecurity strategy across all product development activities within the DDN Business Unit, with a focus on high-speed connectivity solutions used in data center environments. This role ensures that products containing integrated circuits, firmware, and embedded software are designed, validated, and maintained to mitigate cyber threats and prevent unauthorized access or exploitation. The position operates at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and system-level architecture, addressing cybersecurity risks throughout the full product lifecycle—from concept through deployment and sustainment. The Product Security Leader will define and govern the cybersecurity policies, procedures and governance model and oversee the incorporation into the LeanPD process for applicable products.

Job Requirements

1. Product Security Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and lead the business unit’s product cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
  • Establish cybersecurity policies, standards, and secure design principles for hardware, firmware, and embedded software.
  • Define security architecture requirements for high-speed connectivity products (e.g., cables, connectors, active interconnects, modules).
  • Ensure alignment with industry standards (e.g., secure development lifecycle, zero trust principles).

2. Secure Product Development Lifecycle (SPDLC)

  • Integrate cybersecurity into all phases of New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Define and enforce secure coding standards, threat modeling, and design reviews.
  • Ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded in system and component specifications.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement security-by-design practices.

3. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment

  • Identify and evaluate potential attack vectors across:
    • Embedded firmware
    • ASIC/FPGA interfaces
    • High-speed data paths
    • External interfaces (I/O, management interfaces, etc.)
  • Conduct product-level threat modeling and risk assessments.
  • Define mitigation strategies and validate their effectiveness.

4. Vulnerability Management & Testing

  • Establish processes for:
    • Static and dynamic code analysis
    • Penetration testing (internal and third-party)
    • Firmware and hardware security validation
  • Lead root cause analysis and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain vulnerability disclosure and response processes.

.

5. Supply Chain & Component Security

  • Define cybersecurity requirements for suppliers of ICs, firmware, and software components.
  • Assess third-party components for security risks (including open-source software).
  • Implement secure provisioning, authentication, and anti-tampering mechanisms.

6. Product Architecture & System Security

  • Collaborate with system architects to:
    • Design secure communication protocols
    • Implement encryption, authentication, and key management
    • Ensure secure boot, firmware integrity, and update mechanisms
  • Address risks associated with data center deployment environments (e.g., lateral movement, hardware-based attacks).

7. Incident Response & Monitoring

  • Develop and maintain product cybersecurity incident response plans.
  • Support investigation of field incidents and potential breaches involving company products.
  • Coordinate with customers and internal teams during security events.

8. Compliance & Certification

  • Ensure products meet relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards (customer-driven and regulatory).
  • Support audits, certifications, and customer security assessments.
  • Maintain documentation for compliance and traceability.

9. Training & Culture

  • Drive cybersecurity awareness across engineering and product teams.
  • Train engineers on secure design practices and emerging threats.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and advisor to leadership.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field
  • 10+ years in cybersecurity, with strong emphasis on embedded systems and/or hardware-integrated products.
  • Experience in high-speed electronics, data center infrastructure, or networking products strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience implementing secure development lifecycle practices.
  • Technical Expertise
    • Embedded systems security (firmware, RTOS, low-level software)
    • Hardware security (ASICs, FPGAs, side-channel risks, secure elements)
    • Cryptography, secure boot, authentication protocols
    • Network and data path security in high-speed systems
    • Vulnerability assessment tools and penetration testing methods
    • Secure firmware update and key management systems
  • Frameworks Knowledge
    • Secure development lifecycle frameworks
    • Product security standards relevant to data center and networking environments
    • Zero Trust Architecture concepts
  • Standards Knowledge
    • ISO/IEC 27001:2022: The premier international standard, providing a framework for setting up an Information Security Management System (ISMS) to identify and mitigate risks.
    • ISO/IEC 27017/27018: Guidelines specifically for cloud security controls and the protection of personal data in the cloud.
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0: A voluntary, flexible framework focused on protecting critical infrastructure using five core functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover.
    • NIST SP 800-53: Prescribes security and privacy controls for information systems, often mandatory for U.S. federal data centers.
    • SOC 2 Type II: Attestation reports that evaluate internal controls regarding security, availability, and confidentiality.
    • ANSI/TIA-942: Establishes standards for data center design, construction, and operation, including physical security requirements for Tiers 1-4.
  • Leadership & Soft Skills
    • Strong cross-functional leadership (engineering, quality, product management)
    • Ability to influence design decisions without direct authority
    • Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences
    • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capability
  • Ability to prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced dynamic work environment.
  • Willingness to travel as required, ~30%

WE VALUE

  • Knowledge in data center architecture, connectors, wire harnesses, busbars, high speed connectivity products, high voltage, electronics, measurement & signal processing.
  • Experience in product development for data center applications

#TANAUV #datacenters

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

This role will focus on supporting Principal Care Management (PCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Transitional Care Management (TCM) services via telephonic outreach and technology-enabled documentation platforms. Care Coordinators work collaboratively with a team of Registered Nurses and Cardiologists, escalating clinical concerns and complex care needs as appropriate.

This position does not require RN licensure, but candidates must have strong clinical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate complex care environments.

jobs.description:
Ben jij een allround administratieve kanjer, nauwkeurig en zet jij graag de puntjes op de i? Werk jij graag zelfstandig vanuit huis, maar toch als onderdeel van een team? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Over Webmastery

Webmastery is een social media bureau voor organisaties die maatschappelijke impact maken, zoals Alzheimer Nederland, Longfonds, VluchtelingenWerk en De Gezonde Generatie.

We zijn een social enterprise. We bouwen sinds 2012 aan een andere manier van werken. Niet de klassieke kantoorbaan staat centraal, maar onze mensen. We ontwerpen werk rond energie, talent en resultaten, zodat ook mensen die niet passen in het traditionele werkmodel tot hun recht komen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Administratief Medewerker maak je deel uit van het Team Analyses & Administratie. Je voert werkzaamheden uit op het gebied van financiële administratie (zoals het versturen van verkoopfacturen) en personeelsadministratie (bijvoorbeeld het verzorgen van arbeidscontracten en het bijhouden van jobcoachtrajecten). Daarnaast passeren allerlei andere administratieve klussen de revue.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt MBO+-denk- en werkniveau.

  • Je hebt werkervaring in het financiële en administratieve vakgebied en hebt daar ook een opleiding voor gevolgd.

  • Je bent gewend om met Microsoft 365, Exact en Nmbrs te werken.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met AI (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gamma, Claude, Gimini).

  • Met jouw nauwkeurigheid en expertise houd je de verschillende administraties perfect op orde. Naast het kunnen uitvoeren van operationele werkzaamheden heb je ook een signalerend oog.

  • Je vindt het leuk om zelfstandig te werken, maar je weet ook je collega’s goed te vinden als dat nodig is.

  • Je draagt goede doelen, social enterprises en maatschappelijke organisaties een warm hart toe.

  • Je ontvangt een WIA-, WAO-, IVA- of Wajonguitkering en/of staat in het doelgroepregister van het UWV.

Wat bieden we?

  • Een functie voor minimaal 4 uur en maximaal 8 uur per week. We zullen onderling afstemmen wat de meest optimale verdeling van de uren over de week/maand is.

  • Een marktconform brutoloon tussen de € 2.718 en € 4.027 per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. De exacte beloning wordt bepaald met behulp van de salarischeck van Wageindicator (functie ‘Administratief medewerker (mbo niveau)'.

  • € 120 onkostenvergoeding bij 40 uur per week (naar rato bij minder uur).

  • 8% vakantiegeld, maandelijks uitbetaald.

  • 20 vakantiedagen en 7 persoonlijke feestdagen bij 40 uur per week (dus ook naar rato bij minder uur). Je hebt de keuze om deze dagen in te zetten op traditionele feestdagen of op andere momenten.

  • Bijna maandelijks een interessante workshop (niet verplicht).

  • Drie live contactmomenten per jaar (lunch – tuinfeest – werkweek), waarbij medewerkers elkaar fysiek kunnen ontmoeten (niet verplicht).

  • Volop ruimte om te groeien. Bij ons zijn functieprofielen fluïde.

  • Een warm team waarin we echt naar elkaar luisteren.

Wie verwelkomen we graag?

Wij geloven dat veel talent onnodig uitvalt door het keurslijf van de traditionele kantoorbaan. Daarom ontwerpen we werk sinds 2012 rond mensen in plaats van rond vaste tijden, vaste plekken en vaste structuren. Veel collega’s werken bijvoorbeeld liever vanuit huis, hebben baat bij flexibele werktijden of bouwen hun uren rustig op. Daarom werken bij ons relatief veel mensen die bekend zijn bij het UWV, bijvoorbeeld via het doelgroepregister of met een Wajong-, WIA-, WAO- of IVA-uitkering. Ook voor deze vacature nodigen we mensen uit die deze manier van werken omarmen.

We zijn gespecialiseerd in inclusieve communicatie en geloven dat een divers team leidt tot betere en menselijkere communicatie. Verschillende perspectieven, ervaringen, culturen en talen maken ons werk sterker. Daarom verwelkomen we iedereen die wil bijdragen aan een eerlijker en inclusiever online gesprek.

Voor deze vacature zoeken we iemand die ons team structureel komt versterken in loondienst. Daarom nemen we voor deze functie geen sollicitaties van zzp'ers in behandeling.

Iets voor jou?

Herken je je in het profiel? Dan nodigen we je uit om je motivatiebrief en cv uiterlijk 19 juli via dit formulier in te sturen. 👇 Gesprekken vinden plaats in de periode tot 7 augustus.

About ComPsych

ComPsych® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.

About the Role

Our mission at ComPsych is to support the well-being of 160 million lives. Designing the human-centered experiences that support them through life's everyday challenges, and through some of life’s toughest moments that no one should have to work through alone.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will lead design initiatives within our behavioral health and absence management experiences. Together with product managers and engineers, you will create compelling experiences with a high bar for craft and shaped by strong research and a sharp read on UX metrics. To drive the product's direction, you will author and champion transformative experience visions that can reimagine how modern care delivery could work – both front and backstage.

We are building a new product design group that reports through the Chief Strategy Officer, that is both AI-native and deeply human-centered from the start. The right candidate will be excited to have a hand in shaping our design and user research processes alongside their product work. As designer practitioners, we see AI tools as an opportunity to extend our craft, not to replace it.

What You'll Do

  • Own initiatives from discovery through execution. Framing problems, running research, prototyping, and shipping alongside product and engineering.
  • Raise the design maturity of the teams around you. Champion user research and data-driven decision making. You know that success is not having the best idea; it's making sure the best idea gets built.
  • Reduce the time from insight to user outcome. Utilize AI for tasks like research synthesis, prototyping, exploration, documentation, execution, and minimizing hand offs.
  • Partner directly with product, engineering, and subject-matter stakeholders to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into testable user outcomes.
  • Collaborate with your design peers. Participate in collective brainstorming, design crits, and storytelling. Evolve our long-term product vision. Iterate on design systems, visual language, and design principles. This is a team that values your voice in the process.
  • Create journey maps and service blueprints to understand the full end-to-end user experience – front and backstage.
  • Use storytelling to pull the team towards compelling experience visions that drive innovation while connecting user outcomes with business objectives.

What We're Looking For

Design experience can take many forms. If you're strong in the core areas below and excited to collaborate, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification.

  • Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to own experience design end-to-end, from problem framing through delivery and iterative data-led refinements.
  • Strong core UX design skills and craft in execution.
  • Experience designing elegant solutions within complex product domains.
  • A track record of raising the design maturity of teams around you — through mentorship, critique, systems thinking, or influence that extended beyond your own assigned work.
  • Real fluency with AI as a working tool: Prototyping, synthesizing research, faster iterations, designing in code, and staying up to date on the latest tools.
  • Familiar with the capabilities, constraints, and human factors of LLMs, and able to leverage that knowledge into responsibly designed experiences.
  • Inspired toward mission-driven, human-centered work. Passionate about creating products in support of people’s functional and emotional needs.
  • Ability to articulate your process and provide strong rationale for design decisions. Persuasive with peers and executives, and humble enough to change your mind when the evidence says to.
  • Experience working in Agile product delivery teams.
  • Experience in behavioral health, absence management, or another regulated, data-sensitive industry.
  • Accessibility expertise and working knowledge of WCAG 2.2.
  • Strong mobile design skills.

Compensation and Benefits

The pay range for this position is 185,250 - 256,500 CAD per year. Compensation will be determined in accordance with applicable local market rates and legal requirements. Where required by applicable law, salary range information will be provided to candidates during the recruitment process or upon request.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fair, transparent, and merit-based employment practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, or ethnic origin, nationality, religion or belief, disability, pregnancy or parental status, marital or family status, veteran or military status, socioeconomic background, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable local, national, or international law.We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process due to a disability or any other reason, please contact us at and we will work with you to meet your needs.

ComPsych Corporation and its affiliates is committed to the responsible and transparent handling of your personal data. Information collected during the recruitment process will be used to assess your application and, where applicable, to prepare and administer an offer of employment. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the privacy laws applicable in your country or jurisdiction of residence, which may include the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and applicable provincial privacy legislation, and other applicable national or local privacy laws. For full details on what personal data we collect, how we use it, your rights as an Applicant, and how to contact us with privacy-related questions, please review the relevant Applicant Data Privacy Notices: EEA, Switzerland, and UK Data Protection Notice for Job Applicants & Global Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Clinical Adherence Nurse , RN -  Per Diem (Open to Puerto Rican Residents Only)
jobs.excerpt: About Scene Health Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy.
jobs.description:
About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

About the role
We’re looking for a per-diem RN who brings energy, warmth, and authenticity to every patient interaction—especially on video. In this role, you’ll connect with patients through daily video check-ins, offering encouragement, education, and accountability that helps them stay on track with their medications.

The ideal candidate:

  • Is naturally engaging and comfortable speaking on camera
  • Enjoys building rapport quickly through virtual, asynchronous interactions
  • Can motivate and encourage patients in short, meaningful video touchpoints
  • Is passionate about making healthcare more personal, accessible, and supportive

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Clinical Adherence Nurse (RN), you will play a key role in enrolling, engaging, and supporting patients in a high-impact medication adherence program designed to improve health outcomes. This innovative role uses asynchronous video communication and digital engagement to build meaningful patient relationships and deliver personalized clinical support.

Through daily video check-ins, you will connect with patients, offering encouragement, education, and accountability that helps them stay on track with their medications and care plans. Using your clinical expertise and motivational communication skills, you will guide patients through challenges, celebrate progress, and help them build sustainable health habits.

In this role, you will help patients overcome barriers related to social determinants of health, provide tailored education, and monitor medication-taking behavior through video-based interactions. By building trust through engaging video communication, you will inspire patients to actively participate in their care and empower them to take greater control of their health.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct patient outreach and engagement through video messaging, video consultations, phone calls, and text-based communication, educating and enrolling patients into the adherence program
  • Utilize video-based communication as a primary engagement tool to deliver personalized education, coaching, and adherence support
  • Provide compassionate and motivational coaching, case management, and health education services to encourage medication adherence and lifestyle changes
  • Conduct video-based medication reconciliation consultations, ensuring patients understand their medications, dosing schedules, and proper administration techniques
  • Review asynchronous video submissions of patients taking medication, ensuring correct administration, monitoring adherence, and assess for side effects or concerns
  • Create short-form educational and motivational videos to send to patients for personalized engagement and population-level health education
  • Assess patient needs, including medical, behavioral, and social challenges, and escalate cases as necessary
  • Provide guidance on medication administration, inhaler technique, chronic disease management, and medication safety through live and asynchronous video coaching
  • Act as a clinical escalation point for non-clinical team members to send patient cases that need a higher level of clinical review and intervention
  • Assist patients with technical troubleshooting related to the company’s mobile application and adherence platform
  • Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of all interactions, ensuring compliance with company and regulatory guidelines
  • Engage with provider offices, health plan services, and pharmacies on behalf of the patient, as needed, to overcome barriers
  • Provide referrals to healthcare providers and community resources when needed, including direct outreach to provider offices and/or warm transfers to service providers
  • Utilize motivational interviewing techniques within video and digital engagement to engage patients in long-term adherence strategies
  • Offer guidance on inhaler techniques, chronic disease management, and medication safety
  • Contribute to program improvement by providing insights from patient interactions, particularly regarding video engagement, digital adherence monitoring, and patient education strategies
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop and refine video-based patient engagement content, clinical protocols, and educational materials

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a legal resident of Puerto Rico
  • Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing with at least 5 years of nursing experience
  • 5 years of related experience in patient engagement, health education, or care coordination
  • Must be fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to read, write, speak, and understand both languages ​​proficiently
  • Strong background in chronic disease management, medication adherence, and patient coaching
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with a warm, empathetic approach
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, patient-focused environment
  • Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR), mobile applications, and digital health platforms.
  • Comfortable engaging patients via phone, video, and chat throughout the workday
  • Experience assessing social determinants of health and connecting patients with resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in video communication, telehealth, community health work, or digital health settings
  • Certification in health coaching (e.g., Certified Health Coach, Integrative Health Coach, etc.) or willingness to obtain certification within a specified timeframe
  • Knowledge of Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) models
  • Experience working with Medicaid and Medicare Dual Eligible (D-SNP) populations
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work remotely while making a tangible impact on patients’ lives
  • Be part of an innovative healthcare solution addressing a $500B medication adherence challenge
  • Collaborate with passionate professionals across healthcare, technology, and public health sectors
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling company

The biggest perk is that you will be working on a game-changing solution in healthcare with people who are talented, motivated, and passionate. Scene has impacted thousands of lives to date, but you will be integral in scaling that impact.

If you are a compassionate, tech-savvy nurse with a passion for patient engagement and medication adherence, we want to hear from you! Apply today to join us in transforming healthcare and empowering patients toward better health outcomes.

Available shifts include evenings, weekends and holidays.

**Candidates must reside in Puerto Rico and maintain Puerto Rico residency throughout employment. Must be legally authorized to work in Puerto Rico/United States without employer sponsorship; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We believe in reflecting the diversity of our customers and their patients in our team. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Scene is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental ability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Enfermero(a) Clínico(a) de Adherencia (RN) – Bilingüe (Inglés y Español)

Acerca de Scene Health

En Scene Health, nuestro modelo de atención integral 360° fortalece el estándar de excelencia en la adherencia a los medicamentos mediante la Terapia de Observación Directa (Directly Observed Therapy o DOT).

Combinamos acompañamiento personalizado por video, educación en salud y contenido motivacional para conectar a profesionales de la salud, pacientes y sus familias con el fin de enfrentar uno de los mayores desafíos del sistema de salud: el incumplimiento del tratamiento con medicamentos, un problema que representa un impacto estimado de $500 mil millones.

Nuestra aplicación móvil permite que los pacientes se mantengan conectados con un equipo de atención compuesto por farmacéuticos(as), enfermeros(as) y coaches de salud mediante seguimientos diarios por video, desde cualquier lugar y en cualquier momento.

En Scene, hacemos que el proceso de seguir el tratamiento sea más sencillo y motivador. Ayudamos a los pacientes a superar los desafíos relacionados con el uso de sus medicamentos y les brindamos las herramientas y el apoyo necesarios para mejorar su salud, abordando las barreras para la adherencia asociadas a los determinantes sociales de la salud.

⚠️ IMPORTANTE: ESTA OPORTUNIDAD DE EMPLEO ESTÁ DISPONIBLE ÚNICAMENTE PARA PERSONAS QUE SEAN RESIDENTES LEGALES DE PUERTO RICO.

Los candidatos deben residir en Puerto Rico al momento de solicitar y mantener su residencia en Puerto Rico durante toda su relación laboral. Además, deben estar legalmente autorizados para trabajar en Puerto Rico y en los Estados Unidos sin necesidad de patrocinio por parte del empleador. No se ofrece patrocinio de visa para esta posición.

¿A quién buscamos?

Buscamos un(a) Enfermero(a) Registrado(a) (RN) que transmita energía, calidez y autenticidad en cada interacción con los pacientes, especialmente a través de video.

En este puesto, se comunicará diariamente con los pacientes mediante seguimientos por video, brindándoles apoyo, educación y motivación para ayudarlos a mantenerse al día con sus medicamentos y su plan de tratamiento.

El candidato ideal:

  • Se siente cómodo(a) comunicándose frente a la cámara y proyecta confianza de manera natural.
  • Tiene facilidad para establecer una buena relación con los pacientes mediante interacciones virtuales y asincrónicas.
  • Sabe motivar e inspirar a los pacientes a través de mensajes breves y significativos en video.
  • Le apasiona hacer que la atención médica sea más humana, accesible y centrada en el paciente.

Descripción del Puesto

Como Enfermero(a) Clínico(a) de Adherencia (RN), desempeñará un papel fundamental en la inscripción, participación y acompañamiento de pacientes dentro de un programa de alto impacto enfocado en mejorar la adherencia a los medicamentos y los resultados de salud.

Este puesto innovador utiliza comunicación asincrónica por video y herramientas digitales para crear relaciones significativas con los pacientes y brindar apoyo clínico personalizado.

A través de seguimientos diarios por video, acompañará a los pacientes ofreciéndoles orientación, educación y responsabilidad para ayudarlos a cumplir con sus medicamentos y su plan de cuidado. Utilizando su experiencia clínica y excelentes destrezas de comunicación motivacional, ayudará a los pacientes a superar desafíos, reconocer sus logros y desarrollar hábitos saludables a largo plazo.

También apoyará a los pacientes a superar barreras relacionadas con los determinantes sociales de la salud, brindará educación personalizada y supervisará la adherencia al tratamiento mediante interacciones por video. Al generar confianza a través de una comunicación cercana y efectiva, motivará a los pacientes a participar activamente en el manejo de su salud.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Realizar alcance y seguimiento a pacientes mediante mensajes de video, consultas por video, llamadas telefónicas y mensajes de texto para educarlos e inscribirlos en el programa de adherencia.
  • Utilizar la comunicación por video como principal herramienta para ofrecer educación personalizada, orientación clínica y apoyo relacionado con la adherencia al tratamiento.
  • Proporcionar coaching clínico, manejo de casos y educación en salud con un enfoque empático y motivador para fomentar la adherencia a los medicamentos y cambios positivos en el estilo de vida.
  • Realizar conciliaciones de medicamentos mediante consultas por video, asegurando que los pacientes comprendan sus medicamentos, horarios de dosificación y la forma correcta de administrarlos.
  • Revisar los videos enviados por los pacientes mientras toman sus medicamentos para verificar la administración correcta, monitorear la adherencia e identificar posibles efectos secundarios o preocupaciones clínicas.
  • Crear videos educativos y motivacionales cortos para fortalecer el compromiso individual del paciente y promover la educación en salud a nivel poblacional.
  • Evaluar las necesidades médicas, conductuales y sociales de los pacientes y escalar los casos cuando sea necesario.
  • Brindar orientación sobre la administración de medicamentos, el uso correcto de inhaladores, el manejo de enfermedades crónicas y la seguridad de los medicamentos mediante sesiones de video en vivo y asincrónicas.
  • Servir como punto de escalamiento clínico para casos referidos por miembros no clínicos del equipo que requieran una evaluación clínica más especializada.
  • Ayudar a los pacientes con problemas técnicos relacionados con la aplicación móvil y la plataforma de adherencia de la empresa.
  • Mantener documentación completa y precisa de todas las interacciones con los pacientes, cumpliendo con las políticas de la empresa y los requisitos regulatorios.
  • Comunicarse con consultorios médicos, planes médicos y farmacias en representación del paciente cuando sea necesario para ayudar a eliminar barreras de acceso al tratamiento.
  • Referir pacientes a proveedores de servicios de salud y recursos comunitarios cuando corresponda, incluyendo comunicación directa con oficinas médicas y transferencias asistidas a otros proveedores de servicios.
  • Utilizar técnicas de entrevista motivacional durante las interacciones por video y otros medios digitales para fomentar estrategias de adherencia a largo plazo.
  • Ofrecer orientación sobre el uso adecuado de inhaladores, el manejo de enfermedades crónicas y la seguridad en el uso de medicamentos.
  • Contribuir a la mejora continua del programa mediante recomendaciones basadas en la experiencia con los pacientes, especialmente relacionadas con la comunicación por video, el monitoreo digital de la adherencia y las estrategias de educación al paciente.
  • Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para desarrollar y mejorar contenido educativo en video, protocolos clínicos y materiales educativos.

Requisitos

  • Debe ser residente legal de Puerto Rico
  • Licencia vigente como Enfermero(a) Registrado(a) (RN) en buen estado, con un mínimo de cinco (5) años de experiencia en enfermería.
  • Mínimo de cinco (5) años de experiencia en participación del paciente, educación en salud, coordinación de cuidados u otra función relacionada.
  • Dominio completo del inglés y del español (leer, escribir, hablar y comprender ambos idiomas con fluidez).
  • Sólida experiencia en manejo de enfermedades crónicas, adherencia a medicamentos y coaching de pacientes.
  • Excelentes destrezas de comunicación verbal y escrita con un enfoque cálido, profesional y empático.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en un ambiente dinámico y centrado en el paciente.
  • Conocimiento y manejo de expedientes electrónicos de salud (EHR), aplicaciones móviles y plataformas digitales de salud.
  • Comodidad para interactuar con pacientes mediante llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas y mensajería durante toda la jornada laboral.
  • Experiencia evaluando determinantes sociales de la salud y conectando pacientes con recursos disponibles.

Cualificaciones Preferidas

  • Experiencia en comunicación por video, telesalud, salud comunitaria o programas de salud digital.
  • Certificación como Coach de Salud (por ejemplo, Certified Health Coach, Integrative Health Coach u otra certificación equivalente) o disposición para obtenerla dentro del período establecido.
  • Conocimiento de modelos de Terapia de Observación Directa (Directly Observed Therapy o DOT).
  • Experiencia trabajando con poblaciones cubiertas por Medicaid y beneficiarios duales de Medicare y Medicaid (D-SNP).
  • Conocimiento de Salesforce u otras plataformas CRM.

Beneficios y Oportunidades
